notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
New / Adjustments:
-You will not lose your stuff anymore, when dying in the final level.

-I removed the "Delete Game File" - Button in the Options Menu, you can still manage your Game Files in the Launcher.

-In every other level you will lose less than before.
Kunais -5 -> -2
Essence -20 -> -10
Bamboo -30 -> -10
Orange Blades -10 -> -5
Icespikes -5 /still -5
Dragonheart -5 -> -2
Hats -3 -> -1
Skulls -5 -> -1
Blue Hair -5 -> -1
Dark Essence -5 -> -1
Yellow Essence -5 -> -1


Bug Fixes:
-Ingame Currency UI Bug.

-Shop UI Bug with last Item.

-Controller Bug Fix in the Shop.
